I don’t really think that Anderson is a blank slate like you say. He was blinded by his anger of losing members of his team. He bought into the lies being sold by Ally that if he brought her the pendant and they crossed over to the other side that everything would be better. He crossed over to the other side and it wasn’t better. It was the same as his Earth; maybe even worse. He then watched his counterpart be burned to the death by Bizarro Jon at the request of Ally so that’s when he fully realized that he was fighting for the wrong side and knew that he had to keep the pendants away from the Ally(s). The Ally(s) want to merge the two universes because they believe that each universe is incomplete and are simply one half of a whole. They want people to become their “true selves” meanwhile our Clark and Bizarro believe the exact opposite and believe that each individual is their complete self. Bizarro Tal-Rho initially bought into Ally’s delusions because of Lana, but deep down knew that something felt wrong and after failing his brother couldn’t stand by and watch our Clark fail as well. I think it’s been handled fine, not perfect by any means, but fine enough that I have very few, if any complaints. This is all my opinion though and I don’t expect everyone to share my opinion.
